finalFilesystemIdentityReview.rawCiObservation: Run 37107412494 diagnostic reports authority root C:\Users\RUNNER~1\... versus Git root C:/Users/runneradmin/... with missing=[]; string comparison after realpath was still insufficient for short/long names. This is failed-run evidence, not corrected-run success.
finalFilesystemIdentityReview.assessment: Stat comparisons require both operands to be directories, same BigInt device and same BigInt nonzero inode. BigInt avoids precision loss in identity comparison; zero on either side cannot pass. A lexical alias alone does not relax filesystem identity. A distinct repository/subdirectory cannot pass unless the filesystem reports identical nonzero identity. Writes remain confined to original authoritative root and approved paths. Root/Git-root/missing-file diagnostic values do not alter decisions or expose credentials.
finalFilesystemIdentityReview.portabilityLimit: Filesystems that do not report usable nonzero inode identifiers fail closed rather than accepting a potentially ambiguous match. Actual corrected Windows/macOS/Linux CI is still required; no unsupported filesystem capability is claimed.
finalFilesystemIdentityReview.verification: Local production lifecycle tests 4/4 passed. Additional exact-function-source extraction probe with real fixture Git root accepted the root, rejected its child directory, and rejected injected zero-inode stat results. This supplemental probe is deterministic testing of extracted reviewed function source, not real CI/host acceptance.
